templates.title: Mid-season player evaluation
templates.description: A coach fills this in once per player on the roster. It feeds the player's history and the league's team-formation notes for next season. Never shown to other families.

fields.label: Fields routine ground balls and fly balls
Ready to move up a division next season?
One sentence for next year's coach

templates.title: Medical information and emergency contacts
templates.description: Required once per player each season. Seen only by the player's coaches, the safety officer and the league president.

fields.label: Medical conditions the coach should know about (asthma, diabetes, seizures, heart)
Carries an inhaler or EpiPen to games and practices?
I authorize emergency treatment if I cannot be reached

templates.title: Volunteer application
templates.description: Everyone who helps on or near the field completes this once a year. The league runs the background check from these answers.

fields.label: Baseball or coaching experience
fields.hint: None is a fine answer; we train.

fields.label: Previous league volunteered with, if any
I agree to complete the league's coach certification modules before the first practice
The information above is complete and true, and I consent to a background check

templates.title: Feedback for your child's coach
templates.description: Read by the league president and the division commissioner only. The coach sees totals and anonymous text at the end of the season.

fields.label: Communicates practice and game details clearly
Shares playing time and positions fairly
Takes safety seriously (water, weather, pitch counts)

templates.title: Field or equipment request
templates.description: Coaches and board members ask for field time, repairs or equipment. The facilities lead reviews and marks each one handled.
